summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of LinkMint URL shortener. All backend APIs (17/17) and frontend features tested successfully. No critical issues found.
passed_tests: Backend: Health check (mongo:ok, redis:ok)
Backend: URL shortening with auto https:// prefixing (example.com/test → https://example.com/test)
Backend: Custom alias creation, duplicate rejection (409), invalid alias rejection (422), reserved alias rejection (409)
Backend: Invalid URL validation (422 for 'notaurl')
Backend: Expiration validation (future works, past returns 422)
Backend: Resolve code returns URL and increments clicks
Backend: 404 for nonexistent codes
Backend: 302 redirect endpoint (/api/r/{code})
Backend: 410 for expired links
Backend: List links sorted by created_at desc
Backend: Delete link and subsequent 404 on resolve
Backend: Stats endpoint (total_links, total_clicks, active_links)
Frontend: Homepage loads with all UI elements (brand, status pill, form, stats cards, links table)
Frontend: Redis status pill displays 'Redis cache: ok'
Frontend: URL shortening form submission creates short link and displays result card
Frontend: Copy button shows success toast 'Copied. Share it anywhere.'
Frontend: Duplicate alias error shows toast 'This alias is already taken'
Frontend: Recent links table displays with clicks, copy and delete buttons
Frontend: Delete button opens AlertDialog confirmation and successfully removes link
Frontend: Expiration date picker (shadcn calendar) opens and allows date selection
Frontend: Navigate to /{code} shows 'Resolving link…' with destination domain before redirect
Frontend: Navigate to /nonexistent shows error page with 'Back to LinkMint' button
Frontend: Stats cards update correctly after operations (4 links, 3 clicks, 4 active)
